notes_html:
3. Treatment notes

4. Vestibular testing already performed.

5. Current (performed within the past 90 days) clinical audiogram with Air-Conduction/ Bone-Conduction (AC/BC) and Speech Discrimination (SD).

6. Typed personal statement describing the history of the condition. It must include:

  • If there is any family history;
  • Episodes of hearing loss over the last year;
  • The number of episodes with approximates dates and how long each lasted;
  • A description of the severity of the attacks with type of symptoms;
  • Any history of Migraine or drop attacks (collapsing suddenly without fainting),
  • Medication used for control/treatment;
  • Any surgery;
  • Success of control (e.g., How often do you have a recurrence? When was most recent episode?); and
  • Therapy/medication used for control.

If any underlying condition is found, see that page.
